name: TIC 260639893

text.card: A red giant 1,160 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.08 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,893 K at its surface.
